class_secondary_max_003.answer: 160 students per day (Grades 7-12); 150 for required English in Grades 9-12; 135 for Grades 6-8
class_secondary_max_003.evidence: The daily teaching load per teacher for Grades 7-12 shall not exceed one hundred sixty (160) students except for required English classes which are limited to 150 students per day in Grades 9-12 and 135 students per day in Grades 6-8.
